entities.name: Hualien–Taitung line
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Taitung Line, also known as the Hua-Tung line, is the southern section of the Eastern Line of Taiwan Railway. The line starts at the Hualien station and ends at the Taitung station. It is 161.5 km long, including the main segment of 155.7 km between Hualien and Taitung.
